parts.t: Walnut Grove is a residential neighbourhood in northwest Langley, with shops, movie theatres and the Walnut Grove Community Centre. The Golden Ears Bridge connects it to communities north of the Fraser River. It is an established area, planned since 1979, with schools and parks spread through it.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 8, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the Township of Langley.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Walnut Grove has had a community plan since 1979, now part of the Township’s updated OCP.
The Walnut Grove Community Plan (Bylaw No. 1836) was adopted on November 26, 1979, and is now Schedule 6 to the 2025 OCP Update (Bylaw No. 6200).
The plan covers the Walnut Grove Urban Area, with seven residential neighbourhoods and one community service neighbourhood.
The Redwoods Neighbourhood Plan, adopted May 26, 1997, covers about 69.3 hectares around 216 Street, the eastern-most part of Walnut Grove.
The Township’s OCP update includes draft directions for a community plan covering Aldergrove, Fort Langley, Murrayville, Northwest Langley and Walnut Grove.

Walnut Grove is a residential neighbourhood in northwest Langley, in the Township of Langley. The Golden Ears Bridge connects it to communities north of the Fraser River.
What is at the Walnut Grove Community Centre?
A 50 m pool with a waterslide, diving boards and a leisure pool, plus a fitness centre, gymnasium, preschool and a library branch.
Which schools are in Walnut Grove?
Walnut Grove Secondary and elementary schools including Alex Hope, Dorothy Peacock, Gordon Greenwood, James Kennedy, Topham and West Langley. Check the SD35 School Locator for the exact address.
Is there transit in Walnut Grove?
TransLink routes include the 562 (Langley Centre/Walnut Grove) and the 509 (Walnut Grove/Surrey Central Station).
The Walnut Grove Community Plan was adopted in 1979, and the last neighbourhood plan, Redwoods, was adopted in 1997.
What is in Walnut Grove Community Park?

, at 89 Avenue and Walnut Grove Drive, has lighted all-weather and synthetic fields, ball diamonds, tennis, a skateboard park, a spray park, trails and a community garden. The dog off-leash park is at 9550 213 Street.
What does the Walnut Grove Community Plan cover?
covers the Walnut Grove Urban Area, with seven residential neighbourhoods and one community service neighbourhood. It is now Schedule 6 to the Township’s 2025 OCP Update.
